research_question: Which budgeting apps fit which budgeting jobs in 2026, and what do they really cost after trials and promotions?

research_brief.purpose: Compare seven budgeting apps by method, verified price, household use and tradeoffs.

research_brief.scope_limitations: Monarch Plus price, a YNAB multi-currency claim and the Mint shutdown date could not be confirmed on fetched pages and were removed. No hands-on testing.

statistics.claim: YNAB costs $109 per year or $14.99 per month with a 34-day trial.
Monarch Core costs $99.99 per year or $14.99 per month.
PocketGuard costs $12.99 per month, $74.99 per year or $149.99 lifetime.
Rocket Money Premium+ costs $15 per month plus tax.
Goodbudget Premium costs $10 per month or $80 per year.
